title: Private Console topology sparkline + remediation composer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design an embedded topology sparkline plus an escalation / remediation composer for Private/VPC Console cluster pages. The goal is to give operators a compact timeline view of cross-cluster network health, resource contention, and cost deltas with actionable remediation options that can be applied from the UI or exported to runbooks. This ticket covers flows, annotated prototypes, accessibility notes, and engineering handoff artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes a topology sparkline with hover drill into 24h, 7d, 30d ranges
Composer UI exposes preflight cost estimate for each remediation action
Compact mode fits inside existing cluster-details header at 320px wide without horizontal scroll
Design tokens and component specs provided for engineering; Storybook-ready variants documented
Design review feedback from PM and ENG addressed and listed in comments
